title: What types of projects can GenStone be used for? - GenStone
text:
What types of projects can GenStone be used for?

GenStone is commonly used for:

- Accent walls

- Fireplace surrounds

- Garage facades

- Porch columns

- Entryways

- Outdoor kitchens

- Basement feature walls


The panels can be used anywhere you want the look of real stone without the weight or cost.
